This game had so much potential. I remember playing the demo and early versions of the game and it ran flawlessly. Fast connections to matches, even difficulty that kept you going but also kept your ego in check. 

Now? I disconnect back to title screen every match I try to play, even with it installed on an SSD, the game lags heavily, and content has become dull. I don't plan on having this game reinstalled for a long while if this is how the game is going to run. 

I really hate being negative, I always try to be positive, but all the present problems in the game are just way too frustrating.

[Quote][b][URL=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spyware]Spyware Warning![/URL][/b]This game acts as spyware and performs personal data gathering and transmission. It attempts to install the Tencent/CCP backed ACE malware/rootkit into your PC, which cannot be removed cleanly afterwards. This spyware rootkit compromises the integrity of your PC.

The ACE spyware rootkit behaves much like the Red Shell spyware, monitors and reports on all aspects of your PC as well as your browsing history, passwords and online activity. There's no way to opt out and you are forced to agree to a non-enforcable agreement which involves the developer selling your private data and profiling you. This is completely unethical and reprehensible. Gamers must be aware of the dangers of installing this harmful software and should avoid this completely.[/Quote]

[quote][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Loot_box][b]Warning: Loot Box/Gacha Gambling[/b][/url]

This game uses random-chance loot boxes/"gacha" mechanics ("Chance based in-game purchases") to unlock game elements, as a form of gambling and exploits psychological vulnerabilities. This is done for the profit of the developers, regardless of the harm it causes to gamers. This is completely predatory and unethical. Gamers must be aware of the dangers of this predatory monetization and should avoid this completely.[/quote]

[quote][b]Note: Dead Multiplayer game[/b]

This game contains no meaningful single player content. There's no viably populated servers/active player population. This game cannot be played as intended.[/quote]

[quote][b]Warning: Third Party Account[/b]

This game requires you to create a third party "LEVEL INFINITE PASS" account... there's no valid reason for this in a PC game when SteamWorks is available. This is often done to harvest private data and profile you, with potential sale and transmission of your private data to third parties. The developers will probably argue that you can trust them, but if they were trustworthy they wouldn't demand you create a third party account.

This represents a considerable risk to gamers due to the privacy and security implications of developers that wish to bypass Steam and harvest user data. Remember, sometimes if the product is free, YOU are the product.[/quote]

[quote][b][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Microtransaction]Warning: In-Game Cash Shop[/url][/b]

This game is infested with a toxic mobile app style cash shop. You will be prompted to and expected to give money/credit card details to the developers through this cash shop to buy in-game goods so you can play the game.[/quote]

What happened here is that the accountants who have taken over game design built a financial transaction system and loot boxes, and then spent an hour on Friday slapping the thin veneer of a game on top of the monetization in the hopes gamers would see a game and not a toxic cash harvesting monster infested with spyware.  This is not a co-op shooter with any value as a real game, the generic cartoony console peasant skin does not cover P2W, loot box gambling toxicity. Avoid this like the plague.

It's a dead multiplayer game, and it's time for us to have a post-mortem to see some of the reasons this failed.

[i]Most multiplayer-only games on Steam fail.[/i] Very few of them ever go viral. This game failed because the developer expected it to become "virally" popular without creating any actual reason or compelling features. This doesn't do anything that other games already do better.

The market for multiplayer games is crowded and the player base is limited. This game never reached "critical mass", didn't "go viral", and didn't offer anything to differentiate itself enough. Even with no upfront cost, it failed to appeal to gamers for several reasons.

This game lacks any meaningful solo content. The developer tried to use other players as a substitute for real work like level design and story, gambling that just because their game exists, it's going to magically pull the entire player base of Counter-Strike 2 over to this failure instead. They lost that unwise gamble. A game with no players and little to no solo content is a dead game. Developers need to stop relying on players as a substitute for real content, just because they feel creating genuine narrative, level design and so on is "too hard".

Because this is designed for consoles, it carries a number of deliberate design deficiencies. Compromises were made to cater to the inferior console gaming appliances that the game was designed for. These are unfortunate compromises and limitations that PC gamers shouldn't be forced to accept, but it's evident that PC was a second thought for the console-centric developers. The game is deficient as a result of these choices, and would have been so much better without the handicaps that designing games for consoles forces upon a game. Once more, console peasants have made gaming worse for everyone.

As mentioned, this features really godawful, "wrong" looking AI slop instead of genuinely and sincerely created game assets. It's hard to say if this was because the developer didn't have the skill to make real game assets or couldn't afford to hire someone who does, but it also doesn't matter. What matters is that this looks bad because of that decision. AI slop sticks out like a sore thumb... and it comes across as insulting.

There's also the old adage that those who lack the budget and talent to make their own game assets usually lack the budget and talent to do the rest of the job of game development properly, too, and that's glaringly obvious here.

On the important subject of visuals, this features fairly low quality stylised/cartoony low poly 3D graphics. It comes across as the kind of thing you see on mobile phones and Nintendo games, which will deter a lot of PC gamers, understandably. Gaming is a visual medium, and to be considered one of the best games on Steam, the graphics have to be some of the best on Steam. That's not happening here.

You're forced to sign a highly questionable yet legally unenforceable End User License Agreement... for such a relatively low effort, low quality product, this comes across more as a delusion of grandeur than anything else. This agreement includes questionable requirements that may attempt to revoke consumer law protections that gamers expect to have, which is also highly problematic. Developers must learn they are here to serve gamers, not control them. I had my cat walk over the keyboard while the EULA was displaying, which fixed that problem for me.

The developer chose not to do the job of a real game developer and create meaningful bespoke levels, narrative based gameplay progression and so on. Instead, they decided that "Procgen IS content!" and lazily tried to use procgen algorithms to create infinite, samey, repetitive, soulless levels, because that's a lot less work.

As a result of this poor decision, the game gets tired and repetitive almost immediately. Developers must learn that procgen is a terrible substitute for creating real content. It should not be used as "ez-mode" for content creation, as the developer tried to do here.

On the important matter of pricing and value for gamers, there's a lot going on here with monetisation, so this really shouldn't be considered a truly free product because of that.

This game is infested with mobile app store like microtransactions. This is a consumer hostile model that we don't need to see on PC. It's deceptively priced to gouge gamers, and that's a reason in itself to avoid this.

All other issues aside (any of which would disqualify this from being worth your time), this is a game that relies on other players for it to be viable, and because there's not enough players, it's not viable. I can't recommend anyone downloads this, it's basically dead.

The use of AI slop is a direct insult to gamers and real, ethical content creators and artists everywhere.

This game was fun the first season. Even the second season was better because of the new upgrades to equipment and the cores. Now with season 3, it's just repetitive. Same exact levels, same exact bosses, same exact grinding for gear over and over...and over again. It's quite boring now. The first season you could equip the gear you've earned and play the now "classic" mode with it, and it was at least a bit more fun because it was different than the 2 minute levels you have to play with now. Now the gear you earn can only be used in the repetitive modes "cod"etc..just to try and earn more equipment. Rinse and repeat.  it's just boring now. They need new stuff in season 4 or what little following they still have now will be gone completely.

For a ported mobile game, it runs really bad (poorly optimized), it feels like you are running multiple games at the same time, barely finished the tutorial. Design: being flashy & with a basic combat could had been made for kids, but kids which might need a 10k PC to run this f2p malware.

Haven't had stuttering issue like other reviews but the game itself however have a lot of issues.

- Repetitive gameplay. Like other reviewers said, there are literally only one mission objective that is to kill enemies and nothing else. Having like Defense or Survival from Warframe would help a lot.
- Newer characters are locked behind battle pass. This means you are timegated by weekly limit and event (if you start now at least). You can still obtain character for free and premium pass will accelerate the process.
- "Season Tower" is not only repetitive, the relics that will buff you for that mission is not interesting. It usually just "Increase damage/fire rate/etc by x%". I know that you will unlock more as you play but I would like to see a "cursed" item that will have negative effect trade for more powerful effect in midgame

Matchmaking is pretty much dead and having 70 floors of Season Tower didn't help either. So you'll have to go solo or bring some friends.

I'd say overall, it is a good time waster if you have NOTHING ELSE to do.
After so many updates, game is still glitchy. Game modes and boss fights way too short. No longer fun.

Gameplay has taken a massive shift from Season 0/S1 to S2/S3 from roguelite with soft stat upgrades and in-run RNG to almost purely a grinding / build crafting game more akin to a looter shooter which really isn't a positive or negative depending on what you want. The gameplay is kind of bland now but ultimately is somewhat enjoyable BUT the game stutters and or has performance issues constantly. Ever since S0 the game has stuttered heavily, making playing the game headache inducing, and it hasn't even been once mentioned on a known issues list or anything of the sort which means it will probably never get fixed. 
Finally, I liked this game so much when it came out I actually took the time to record and report actual bugs I've encountered in-game but was always met with a 'we don't see an issue here' type reply even after documenting a proper way to replicate AND fix the bugs. After that, I kind of just lost all hope for anything being fixed. Oh yeah also the last two update posts on Steam has had so little effort put into them that they couldn't even bother to put it through google translate, so it's probably over.

Abysmal performance and UI design, a hundred different places in the menus you have to claim rewards after each run is just bad design. It is a cluttered mess of a UI. The idea of the game is cool, but good lord, the stuttering and lag is rediculous. You want people to drop money on this game, but the game can't run for atleast 10 seconds without stuttering, and always when you're in combat, getting only worse as time goes on. Hitting as low as 8 FPS when facing bosses when the rest of the game runs above 60.

Didn't pay much mind to the original user reports on the performance, but having experienced this alongside my friend having the same issues firsthand now, this needs a fix, and badly.

The overall game isn't bad, the UI and performance needs a lot of work though. Progression is pretty solid too, but in its current state, I cannot recommend this game in good faith.
